name: dmengine-fumo-download-update-multi
description: Mode C multi-component combined FUMO command: the mock sends Exec on ./ManagedObjects/FUMO/DownloadAndUpdate and serves the 291-byte two-component/three-update DP. The engine downloads it, advances FUMO state 30 -> 40 -> 60, hands event 77 with /update//lab-fumo to the OEM handler, then reports lab result 200 (state 90 -> idle). The result is lab-supplied and the package is structural; no physical install is claimed.
